notes.title: Switch to 3D Annonce
notes.notes:
Hello,

Almost a year ago, I decided that the 3D format would suit me better, although, of course, it turned out to be more challenging to develop due to the lack of a team. I want to inform you that development is ongoing. The game has slightly shifted its focus—guilds are no longer the central element. Instead, you will have the freedom to decide what to do with the settlement or settlements you establish.

The game has become larger and more diverse. For example, the number of races has increased from 21 to 68, and the number of biomes has grown from 6 to 77. A separate page will be created for the new game. Later, in a future update, I will provide a link to where this game will be moving.

Thank you to those who are waiting! I want to create an interesting and unique product, bringing my dreams of RPGs and strategy games to life—offering a great variety of races, limitless crafting possibilities, and unrestricted build creation.
